description: The closed set of v2 operations the studio frontend may consume, including the GAS-7 HR-D review routes (display and verbatim relay only, owner ruling HR-1) and, since front-door seam 6 (FD-10), the one relayed start of the worker's own shadow run, since seam 7 (FD-11) the one read of the worker's own audit ledger by correlation id, since seam 8 (FD-12) the typed data-use declaration intake whose only write is declare, and since seam 9 (FD-13) the typed vendor-dependency intake on the same terms. Separate from the v1 manifest because the two contracts are frozen independently. Under owner ruling SD-2 no operation naming issue, activate, revoke, grant, authorize, clear or execute may ever appear here; verify-v2-api-boundary.mjs re-derives that from the contract rather than trusting this file. The v2 contract carries one operation this list deliberately omits: v2_export_read (clearance export, CE-5). CE-5 ruled one server-side read and no screen; the frontend consumes nothing new, so the browser-reachable surface was unchanged by it. Since ruling MA-2 as amended (ADR_UGENCE_MODULE_ADMINISTRATION_SCOPING.md MS-1 to MS-5) this list held twenty-six: the twenty-sixth is v2_observe_deployment, the Status panel's one read of the deployment's own startup attestation (seam states, checks and pins; no registry rows, nothing probed live). Since owner ruling BW-3A (ADR_UGENCE_AUTHORITY_PLANE_SCOPING.md section 24, Bring Your Workflow phase 3A) it holds twenty-nine: v2_workflow_drafts_save, v2_workflow_drafts_list and v2_workflow_drafts_read, the Bring Your Workflow screen's draft intake, whose only write keeps a validated document as an unapproved DRAFT for the deployment's tenant and confers nothing. Approving v2_export_read here would still be widening the frontend boundary without a ruling that asked for it.
